# Abram's Nation

> Abram's Nation is a specialized manufacturer of adaptive products for children with special needs, centered around The Safety Sleeper® enclosed bed and complementary sensory and wearable solutions.

Founded in Gibsonia, PA, Abram's Nation serves families with special needs children by providing innovative safety and sensory products. The company has received recognition including SBA Exporter of the Year and maintains partnerships with autism service organizations.

## Key Topics

- [The Safety Sleeper](https://www.abramsnation.com/pages/the-safety-sleeper): Main product page for The Safety Sleeper® enclosed bed with Medicaid info

- [Sensory Development](https://www.abramsnation.com/pages/sensory-development): Sensory products including Weight Mate, Fidget Mat, and Fidget Folder
